Title: RedMed Band
Body (HTML):
Blank medical-ID wristband. Passive 13.56 MHz HF NFC with a genuine NXP NTAG216 chip (888 bytes). Ships empty and unlocked — the RedMed iOS app writes your card. No Bluetooth. No RedMed cloud for your profile.

Outer face ships with standard laser: MEDICAL ID / TAP PHONE → CARD / REDMED (or blank stock until production engraving is online). Chip is never pre-written.

How it works

  1. Put the band on.
  2. In RedMed, open the NFC tab and Write (Face ID).
  3. A stranger or EMT taps a phone to the band (~1–2″). The card opens in the browser. No app install. No login.

Walk-by (~6–8″) does not fire. Want name / ICE / allergy lasered on the reverse? See RedMed Band — Custom.

Not included

  • No pre-written URL or social-media link
  • No payment / access-control mode
  • Not Bluetooth. Not a medical device.

Title: RedMed Band — Custom
Body (HTML):
Custom laser-engraved medical-ID wristband. Same blank NXP NTAG216 chip (13.56 MHz HF NFC) — the RedMed app still writes the card. We only laser the silicone / plate. No cloud medical record. No social URL on the chip.

Outer face (fixed)

MEDICAL ID
TAP PHONE → CARD
REDMED

Reverse (your text — fill at checkout)

[NAME]
ICE [PHONE]
ALLERGY: [ONE LINE]
BLOOD [TYPE]

Rules: all caps. Name = given + surname (no DOB on the face). ICE = one phone number. Allergy = single worst line. Blood only if known — omit if unknown. Optional: if no allergy, one COND: token instead.

Chip ships empty / unlocked. You Write in the RedMed NFC tab after delivery. Engraving is backup for when nobody has an NFC phone — it is not the full card.

Lead time — made to order after engraving fields are confirmed. Custom / engraved bands are final sale once lasered.

Not a medical device. Call emergency services first.
